confirmedCodePaths.fact: Component initialization runs on the application main thread.
Diagnostics is registered during main-thread component initialization.
Capture starts a 100 ms precise GUI heartbeat, performing elapsed-time calculation and JSON ring-buffer append.
The 1000 ms sampler synchronously queries the current process and enumerates the Windows process table and descendants on this same thread.
Windows snapshot and process-stat queries can instead be performed by one bounded background job; no current worker is used.
Capture adds one latency ping each second, with at most one outstanding reply; capture-off performs no native ping.

productionPathReview: Synchronous process-stat enumeration is a confirmed avoidable GUI workload. The heartbeat records and native latency probes are additional measured capture work.
limitations: No retained per-operation timing or trace links any code path to the pair-three p95 change.
The benchmark duration residual cannot identify Windows timer resolution, scheduling, process enumeration or heartbeat as its cause.
